640a107426: 🥩 Espetada — large, juicy pieces of beef grilled on a bay-wood skewer. Traditionally served with bolo do caco and milho frito
060a51ea8b: 🍞 Bolo do caco — traditional soft flatbread made with sweet potato. Best ordered warm with garlic butter
a76c37de89: 🌽 Milho frito — fried cubes of cornmeal with cabbage. One of Madeira’s most typical side dishes, especially with espetada, but also good with fish
6c85b38d98: 🐟 Filete de espada com banana — breaded black scabbardfish fillet with fried banana. Madeira’s best-known fish dish
38355bf37a: 🍋 Espada com maracujá — black scabbardfish fillet with a sweet-and-sour passion fruit sauce. A more tropical version of classic espada
5cb7a8cfb5: 🐟 Bife de atum — tuna steak, usually marinated and pan-fried. A good choice for fish lovers
d91dfe221a: 🐙 Polvo à lagareiro — octopus roasted or fried with olive oil, garlic and potatoes
24fd03509e: 🐙 Polvo à vinagrete — a cold octopus starter dressed with olive oil, vinegar, onion and herbs. Good with wine or poncha
83735ad77e: 🦪 Lapas grelhadas — local limpets grilled in their shells. Served hot with garlic, butter, parsley and lemon
8bb6411020: 🐟 Atum à escabeche — tuna in a spiced marinade with vinegar, onion and seasonings
129ffd3555: 🦑 Lulas grelhadas — grilled squid with garlic, olive oil and lemon
5e9fd5a4bd: 🦐 Camarão ao alho — prawns with garlic and butter or olive oil. Order bolo do caco to soak up the flavourful sauce
63f7884566: 🦐 Camarão grelhado — large grilled prawns with lemon and garlic sauce. A particularly good choice at seaside restaurants
7d1106e2e8: 🍚 Arroz de marisco — seafood rice, usually with prawns, mussels, squid, shellfish and fish in a fragrant tomato broth. Often served as a portion for two
decaa53112: 🍝 Tagliatelle com camarão — tagliatelle with prawns in a cream, tomato or garlic-and-olive-oil sauce. A good alternative if you want seafood without fish
31e9a8beb9: 🍝 Massa de marisco — pasta with mixed seafood: prawns, squid, mussels and sometimes octopus. Usually worth sharing between two
3e2e906724: 🍲 Cataplana de peixe e marisco — a large dish for two or a group, cooked in a special closed copper vessel. It contains fresh fish, prawns, squid, mussels, shellfish, tomatoes, onions and herbs
165b938138: 🐟🦐 Prato misto de peixe e marisco — a large mixed platter of grilled fish and seafood: fish of the day, squid, prawns, octopus, mussels or limpets. Best shared by 2–4 people

5decdd5ff0: 🍪 Broas de mel — small spiced honey biscuits, crisp outside and soft inside
442e375e0d: 🧁 Queijada da Madeira — a small sweet pastry made with soft cheese, eggs and sugar. Ideal with espresso
148d62a32c: 🥧 Pastel de nata — a classic Portuguese puff-pastry tart with smooth egg custard. Best still warm, with espresso and a pinch of cinnamon
a4fe28bab9: 🍍 Maracujá — passion fruit: try it in desserts, sauces, ice cream or drinks
b8a0b91281: 🍌 Banana da Madeira — small, fragrant Madeiran bananas. A classic local pairing is with espada fillet

a22a53060d: 🍺 Coral — Madeira’s local beer, a light pale lager with a mild taste. Good with seafood, espetada and snacks
